scientific_integrity: The new claim concerns the history-conditioned off-episode age and far-field trap-state posterior. Prior stationary mixture formulas are attributed. Analytic proofs and separately executable deterministic checks are provided; independent verification is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite spatial dimension; strictly positive constant switching rates, diffusivity, and active trap relaxation; zero drift during trap-off phases; stationary conditional laws and an infinite-distance asymptotic. The gamma-Gaussian stationary marginal is known prior work. No finite-threshold error bounds, independent scholarly novelty validation, or non-Markovian extension.
title: A nonconcentrating Beta law for the age of extreme untrapped excursions
